item.description: Looking to complement your ethnic outfits with the perfect hairstyle? Discover 6 elegant and trendy hair ideas from braids to and half-up styles that enhance traditional attire. Whether attending a wedding festival or family celebration these looks are sure to turn heads.

item.title: Non-engineering courses that promise high salaries
item.description: Are high paying careers possible without an engineering degree? With students increasingly opting for business, finance, law, data and creative streams, non engineering courses are turning into powerful gateways to top salaries and global job opportunities.

item.title: Goa nightclub claims 25 lives after Cylinder blast; Eyewitnesses reveal terrifying moments
item.description: A massive fire at Goa’s Arpora-based Birk Nightclub claimed 25 lives after a suspected cylinder blast triggered a swift blaze late at night. Heavy crowd due to a DJ–dancer performance worsened the chaos, leaving many trapped. Several employees and tourists died of suffocation.

item.title: Parliament Committee summons Airlines, DGCA over IndiGo crisis
item.description: IndiGo flight cancellations across the country created widespread chaos for passengers, prompting the Parliamentary Committee on Transport, Tourism, and Civil Aviation to summon all airlines, DGCA, and aviation ministry officials.

item.title: The MTA Speaks: How Putin’s visit reshapes India-Russia ties? Key deals and strategic outlook
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin’s two-day visit to India strengthened India–Russia strategic ties. During the 23rd annual summit in New Delhi, 19 key agreements were signed across defense, energy, trade, space, and technology. Amid global tensions, analysts see this visit as a signal of deeper cooperation. Veteran journalist Manoj Tibrewal Aakash explained the visit on his show.

item.title: Goa nighclub fire taagedy exposes lapses in fire safety norms; Legal action initiated
item.description: A devastating fire at Goa’s Birch by Romeo Lane nightclub claimed 25 lives, including foreign tourists, and injured seven. Preliminary investigations reveal severe lapses in fire safety, with blocked exits and faulty alarms. Police and fire departments are investigating, and legal action has begun against the club management.

item.title: Delhi shrouded in smog, air quality remains hazardous; Check AQI here
item.description: Delhi woke up to a blanket of smog on Sunday, with the AQI hitting 303, categorized as ‘very poor’. Key areas like Anand Vihar, ITO, and Ashok Vihar reported thick haze.

item.title: Ranveer Singh ‘Dhurandhar’ beats expectations; ‘Tere Ishq Mein’ nears 100 crore
item.description: Ranveer Singh’s film ‘Dhurandhar’ has made a blockbuster start at the box office, earning 59.60 crore in two days. The movie’s success has impacted the earnings of ‘Tere Ishq Mein’, which has now earned 92.90 crore in nine days.

item.title: IndiGo Crisis: Shares plunge in 5 days; Flight cancellations trigger passenger panic
item.description: IndiGo’s five-day operational crisis has caused massive flight cancellations and severe inconvenience for passengers. Simultaneously, the airline’s shares plunged 8.76%, hitting investors hard. DGCA has issued notices to IndiGo’s top management, citing planning and resource management failures.
